claims.statement: A distributor is the store (门店) concept — one row in distribution_distributor, the pickup/delivery shop a member selects at checkout — owned by ecshopx-distribution, while the promoter (推广员/分销员, member-turned-referrer with QR codes and brokerage rows) is owned by ecshopx-popularize; the two bundles split the 'distribution' namespace between store concepts and promoter concepts.

distribution_distributor_items (the per-shop copy of the catalog) is populated by the goods bundle, not the distribution bundle: DistributorGoodsSyncService.syncGoods in ecshopx-goods and job:62 DistributionBundle\Jobs\AddDistributorItems perform the fan-out to stores flagged auto_sync_goods.

DistributorCreateService.performInsertAndEvents enforces per-company application-level uniqueness guards — duplicate shop_code (店铺编号已存在), mobile (店铺手机号已存在), wdt_shop_no (旺店通门店已绑定其他店铺), jst_shop_id (聚水潭店铺已绑定其他店铺), and the distributor_self singleton (总部自提店铺已存在) — plus mobile format validation that also accepts the synthetic WeCom d-d-d mobile pattern.

The first non-wxapp-sourced store becomes the company default automatically: needDefault = sourceFrom != 2 && !existsDefaultDistributor(companyId); source 1 is admin, 2 wxapp self-registered, 3 openapi.

DistributorCreateOrchestrator registers a TransactionSynchronization whose afterCommit enqueues job:63 (ThemeBundle\Jobs\CreateDistributorJob, slow queue, ASYNC REDIS) BEFORE calling distributionAddEventDispatchPublisher.publish, and that publisher publishes the same row snapshot twice — event:281 and event:289, both ASYNC REDIS — a deliberate dual CSV-plane publish.

The dual DistributionAdd publishes split their listeners by bus plane: event:281 carries the third-party marketing-center push (listener:thirdparty.distribution_add_push_marketing_center, async default queue) and youshu, while event:289 carries the HfPay HfEnterapplyInit listener (async default queue).

DistributorCreateEvent (event:263) is published inside the create transaction in SYNC mode — DispatchOptions.eventDefaults() is DispatchMode.SYNC — so listener SystemLinkBundle\Listeners\ShopCreateSendOme runs inline before commit while shuyun.open_platform.shop_sync_on_distributor_create runs async; the same pattern applies to DistributorUpdateEvent (event:264) with ShopUpdateSendOme on update.

DistributorUpdateOrchestrator afterCommit publishes DistributionEditEvent first (dual CSV event:282 + event:290, ASYNC REDIS — 282 carrying marketing-center push and youshu, 290 carrying HfPay HfEnterapplyInit@edit) and only then DistributorUpdateEvent (event:264, SYNC).

DistributorUpdateService.performUpdateAndEvents applies only a whitelisted COLUMN_KEYS set (61 column names) via per-column setters, forces is_default=1 when no default exists, enforces the update-side WDT/Jushuitan uniqueness guards, and when is_audit_goods flips from true to falsy it bulk-approves all shop-scoped items via ItemsAuditByDistributorJdbcRepository.updateAuditStatusApprovedByDistributorId — disabling item audit must not leave submitted items stuck.

PUT /distributor/{id}/payment-subject parses payment_subject through a sealed interface PaymentSubjectParse with three outcomes: Valid(0|1), Invalid (Dingo 422 payment_subject参数错误，只能为0（平台）或1（店铺）), and SqlBug — a missing/null/empty-string value deliberately reproduces the legacy MySQL 1366 'Incorrect integer value' error as HTTP 200 with Dingo message/status_code 500, matching the old client contract.

DistributorPaymentSubjectService.setPaymentSubject refuses to switch while the store has unfinished refunds (有未完成的退款单，不允许切换收款主体); switching to shop subject (1) requires at least one open payment channel (WeChat Pay or Alipay) and complete per-shop channel config for every open channel, while switching to platform (0) validates the platform (distributor 0) channel config.

The legacy PHP route POST …/v1/shops (Javadoc-referenced as DistributorShopController#createShops, with no separate Java controller class) is converged onto the same DistributorCreateOrchestrator and shares its afterCommit job/event publish order with POST /api/v1/distributor; the entry03_shopsCreateRoute_* case in DistributorCreateOrchestratorDistributionAddDispatchPublishProbeTest asserts this route parity.

OpenapiThirdApiV2DistributorCreateService.executeOpenapiCreate is a third distributor-create entrypoint that bypasses the orchestrator: it inserts the row directly in a TransactionTemplate with source_from=3, is_valid=false, review_status=true, and encrypted contact/mobile, then in afterCommit enqueues job:63, the dual DistributionAdd publish, and DistributorCreateEvent — all three entrypoints end with the same fan-out shape.

job:63 ThemeBundle\Jobs\CreateDistributorJob is handled by CreateDistributorJobHandler in ecshopx-theme which delegates to PagesTemplateNewDistributorFacade.applyDefaultTemplatesForNewDistributor in ecshopx-distribution to bind default storefront page templates for the new store.

Merchant wxapp login (POST /api/v1/h5app/wxapp/merchant/login, mobile + SMS vcode + company_id) finds or creates the merchant_settlement_apply row by (company_id, mobile) (new row initial audit_status=1, source=h5, disabled=true) and returns an HS256 JWT issued by MerchantWxappJwtIssuer with subject merchantaccount_{id} and claims account_id/company_id/mobile/operator_type=user plus iss/nbf/exp from MerchantWxappJwtProperties; since ECX-10617 this dedicated token only still authenticates GET /type/list — the settlementapply/** and password/reset endpoints moved to the mall-member @FrontAuth plane, where MerchantSettlementApplyMemberResolveService instead finds-or-creates the apply row by user_id.

The merchant FrontAuth JWT plane has two guards with the same verification logic — the servlet-level MerchantWxappJwtAuthenticationFilter and the annotation-driven MVC FrontMerchantAuthInterceptor — both verifying the HS256 signature, issuer, and exp/nbf with leewaySeconds and then reloading the merchant_settlement_apply row (a deleted apply invalidates an unexpired token). Since ECX-10617 the filter's shouldNotFilter skips settlementapply/** and password/reset (those are now @FrontAuth mall-member endpoints), so the filter only still guards GET /api/v1/h5app/wxapp/merchant/type/list; the MerchantWxappPasswordResetSecurityConfig is a deprecated empty shell. A refused apply stays authenticated because step 3 re-submission resets audit_status back to pending.

Merchant settlement apply saves persist only steps 1–3 (1: settled_type validated against the platform allow-list plus the normalized main_category_selection JSON; 2: merchant identity/address/bank with encrypted PII legal_cert_id/card_id_mask/bank_mobile; 3: the final submit requiring submit=true, setting disabled=false and resetting a refused apply back to pending audit_status=1); the save service refuses edits once audit_status=2 and rejects any step ahead of the resolver with 入驻信息填写步骤错误. The progress resolver derives four states: disabled=false → 4 (submitted/awaiting audit), license_url set → 3, step 1 complete (settled_type + non-empty main_category_selection JSON) → 2, else 1.

Only audit_status=1 (pending) applies are auditable (MerchantSettlementApplyAuditService.settlementApplyAudit, admin); a passing audit (audit_status=2) materializes the merchant row (mirroring apply fields plus settlement_apply_id, audit_goods, settled_succ_sendsms=1, disabled=false), its multi-language shards via MerchantOutsideLangWriteService, and the main operator via CompanysMerchantMainOperatorProvisioner in ecshopx-companys, then enqueues job:1 AuditSuccessNotice, while failure (audit_status=3) enqueues job:2 AuditFailNotice; the apply row is then updated with the outcome, audit_goods flag, optional audit_memo, and updated timestamp (jobs 3/4 are enter-success and password-reset notices).

Salesperson wxapp auth is session-header based, not JWT: QywxSalespersonAuthInterceptor (@QywxSalespersonAuth-annotated handlers) delegates to WxappSalespersonSessionAuthService, which reads x-wxapp-session from the shared wechat Redis as frontSession3rd:{token}, cross-checks the session JSON against the DB shop_salesperson row (company_id + work_userid + allowed salesperson_type + is_valid=true, throwing 会话与库不一致 on type mismatch), lets the DB salesperson_id override the session's, and injects distributor_id from the first store_type=distributor shops_rel_salesperson row ordered by lowest shop_id (0 when unbound).

Admin /api/v1/salesperson/task CRUD creates tasks of types 1–4 (share, new-user, user-order, user-welfare) scoped to all distributors (use_all_distributor=1) or a selected subset, and rejects overlapping same-type tasks in the time window with 此时间段存在该类型任务 via countOverlappingAllDistributorTasks/countOverlappingPartialTasks.

Salesperson task completion enqueues job:45 SalespersonTask (handled by SalespersonTaskJobHandler, which pushes completion to the marketing center via MarketingCenterTasksCompletePort); member↔guide relationship continuity is job:46; shelf recomputation is job:138 SalespersonItemsShelvesJob; and job:139 through job:149 are aliases of the same bus message name — one handler registration, many legacy PHP trigger rows.

On trade finish, NormalOrderFinishBrokerageCoordinator.onNormalOrderFinishBrokerage computes first-level brokerage inside its own transaction: it skips unless the company's open_popularize setting is literal-true, is idempotent per order (existing brokerage rows short-circuit), requires the buyer to be a promoter with a pid parent who is an active promoter (is_promoter=1), computes the rebate as order base (money or profit per config) × first-level ratio percent rounded and capped at Integer.MAX_VALUE fen, inserts a brokerage row of type first_level, and enqueues the promoter grade-upgrade job.
Promoter QR codes are WeChat unlimited-type codes (WxaUnlimitedQrcodeClient.getUnlimitedCodeBytes, scene puid=) returned base64-encoded to the front end.

CommunityChiefQrWriteoffService.executeQrWriteoff is the group-buy write-off path: it resolves the ziti QR code from Redis to an order, requires the community_order_rel_activity row to belong to the invoking chief (只能核销自己开团的订单), rejects already-DONE orders (该订单已完成自提，请重新确认) and orders with pending cancel requests (订单有未处理的取消申请，不能核销), then delegates the state transition to NormalOrderZitiWriteoffService.orderZitiWriteoffForChief in the orders bundle rather than duplicating order status logic.

supplier_order rows are per-supplier projections created by SupplierOrderSplitOnNormalOrderAddService.split (physically in ecshopx-orders, package cn.shopex.ecshopx.supplier.service): for each distinct supplier it inserts one row with aggregated fen sums and NOTPAY statuses, guarded by an existence check on (company_id, order_id, user_id, supplier_id) so re-running is a no-op; the production trigger is a direct synchronous call in both normal-order-create orchestrators (after the transactional runner, before publishing event:orders:normal_order_add), while OrdersSupplierOrderSplitOnNormalOrderAddDispatchListener wraps the same service on the bus plane with no production registration — only tests register it.

Distributor deletion is soft only — is_valid is a string axis set to delete, never a physical delete — and money amounts in this domain are integer fen (brokerage_fee, supplier order sums), with HfPay rate in basis points and payment_subject 0=platform / 1=shop collection.

The afterCommit orderings and dual publishes are pinned by dedicated tests: DistributorCreateOrchestratorDistributionAddDispatchPublishProbeTest (create, including the entry03_shopsCreateRoute_* legacy-route case), DistributorUpdateOrchestratorDistributionEditDispatchPublishProbeTest (update), the DistributionAdd/DistributionEdit dual-publish facade probe tests, and the DistributorCreate/UpdateEvent SYNC bus dispatch flow tests.

pos_store_account rows are per-store POS terminal staff accounts with globally unique case-insensitive employee_no (uk_employee_no), reversible password_cipher, role in store_manager/supervisor/clerk, and status enabled/disabled/resigned; resigned is terminal — status cannot transition back and role change, shop transfer, and password reset all refuse resigned accounts.

POS store account access is scoped by the operator JWT: non-admin operators can read and mutate only accounts whose distributor_id is in their JWT distributor_ids (PosStoreAccountScope), and PosStoreAccountController (/api/v1/store/pos-accounts) is @AdminAuth-guarded with route alias store.pos_account for DataPass/Activated.

POS account passwords are never operator-chosen: PosStoreAccountPasswordGenerator builds an 8-char password guaranteed to contain a letter and a digit (SecureRandom + shuffle), PosStoreAccountPasswordService stores only the SensitiveFieldEncryptor ciphertext, and plaintext surfaces only in the create/reset-password responses and the super-admin-only CSV export, which decrypts passwords.

POS account create and import call PosStoreAccountDigiOsCreatePort.ensureSyncedOnCreate before the local write: when the company's DigiOS config is enabled, the @Primary impl in ecshopx-digios upserts via the account.upsert gateway method (mobile mandatory) and any failure aborts the local create/import with BadRequest; when disabled the PosStoreAccountDigiOsCreatePortNoOp default makes the hook a pass-through.

A successful POS account insert publishes event:companys:pos_store_account_create with {id, company_id, employee_no} after commit (immediately when no transaction synchronization is active) through PosStoreAccountCreateEventDispatchPublisherImpl in bootstrap.

POS account import enters through the espier upload plane: file type pos_store_account (Chinese headers mapped by EspierUploadHeaderCatalog) routes rows via PosStoreAccountEspierImportRowSink to PosStoreAccountImportService.acceptRow, which resolves the shop by shop_code, upserts on existing employee_no (update) or inserts with a generated password, and rejects duplicate employee numbers within one file via an in-memory acceptedKeys set.

POS account export is admin-only and asynchronous: POST /export enqueues job:10 EspierBundle\Jobs\ExportFileJob (ASYNC REDIS, slow queue) with type=pos_store_account; the bootstrap EspierExportFileJobDispatchHandler routes by type to PosStoreAccountExportFileJobTypeHandler in ecshopx-espier, which rebuilds the scoped query, decrypts passwords, writes the CSV, and records the export-log entry.

DigiOS store-profile sync attaches to the distributor lifecycle purely as registered listeners: DigiOsDistributorCreate/UpdateDispatchListenerRegistrationConfig bind listener:digios.distributor_sync_on_distributor_create/update to event:263/264 (async default queue); the listeners extract company_id and distributor_id and DigiOsDistributorSyncDispatchService skips silently unless the company's DigiOS config is enabled, then reloads the row and pushes the store profile (create also provisions the warehouse).

DistributorCreateParamNormalizer and DistributorUpdateParamNormalizer mutate the merged params between gate and validator: merchant operators are pinned to their merchant_id with distribution_type=1, distributor operators have is_audit_goods/auto_sync_goods stripped, a truthy is_open scales rate from percent to basis points (0–3000), offline_aftersales cascades to _self, regions lists back-fill province/city/area, and on create every aftersales distributor id is DB-validated to belong to the same merchant.

PosStoreAccountQueryService.mapOrderInfoByIds is the cross-bundle read surface: order list/detail code batch-loads POS handler info (id, employee_no, name, mobile, role, distributor_id, status — never the password) as the order-side pos_store_account_info object.

POS terminal auth is a dedicated JWT plane: POST /api/v1/pos/auth/login (PosAuthController → PosAuthService.login) takes employee_no + password, loads the account by globally-unique employee_no, decrypts password_cipher for a plaintext comparison (any failure path throws the same 账号或密码错误), enforces account status (disabled → 账号已禁用, resigned → 账号已离职) and the shop's is_valid (true/false/1/0 log in, closed → 门店已闭店, delete → 门店已撤店), then returns the token plus an account snapshot.

The POS JWT (PosJwtIssuer in ecshopx-espier behind the common PosJwtIssuerPort) is HS512, keyed from JWT_SECRET, with sub = pos_store_account id, iss = POS_JWT_ISSUER (default ecshopx-pos), jti/iat/nbf/exp (JWT_TTL minutes, default 120), and claims token_kind=pos (so POS and operator tokens are not interchangeable), id/pos_store_account_id, employee_no, employee_id (same value as employee_no, doubling as the DigiOS acc), name, role, company_id, distributor_id, status.

PosJwtAuthenticationFilter engages only for Bearer tokens that look like POS tokens (token_kind=pos or the POS issuer) and then enforces PosJwtPathWhitelist — exact auth paths plus prefix families (/api/v1/order*, /aftersales*, /checkout*, /operator/cart*, /writeoff/*) and a set of exact GETs/POSTs — with /api/v1/store/pos-accounts* explicitly denied; after the whitelist it checks the Redis blacklist and runs the live session validator before setting the POS_JWT_USER_DATA request attribute.

POS tokens are revocable and scoped: logout (POST /api/v1/pos/auth/logout) blacklists the token via PosJwtBlacklistService in prism Redis (key pos_jwt_invalidate:{sha256(token)}, TTL = remaining token lifetime), and PosJwtSessionValidator.assertSessionStillValid reloads the pos_store_account row per request and 401s unless the row exists, is enabled, and the token's status/distributor_id/role still match — so disable, resign, shop transfer, or role change kills outstanding tokens immediately without waiting for expiry.

GET /api/v1/pos/auth/me (PosMeService) reloads the account (must still be enabled) and returns the profile plus shop_code/shop_name and the fixed three-role permission matrix from PosPermissionMatrix: eight codes (cashier, refund, day_close, shift_handover, member_query, stock_check, report, store_setting); store_manager gets all, supervisor gets all but store_setting, clerk only cashier/shift_handover/member_query, and the document policy is view=store_all with operate=store_all vs own_only for clerks.

The employee account management list (GET /api/v1/account/management, EmployeeController.getListData → EmployeeManagementListService.getListData) is readable by operator and POS JWTs (DualJwtSupport, with pos_store_account_id filling the operator_id slot for cashier read-only use) and, since ECX-10728, honors a shop_name filter: applyShopNameFilter resolves matching distribution_distributor ids by name and intersects them with any already-scoped distributor_ids, forcing operator_ids=[-1] (an empty page) when there is no match so an out-of-scope shop_name never leaks an unfiltered list.

The `payment_subject` column on `distribution_distributor` (smallint, default 0, comment 收款主体，0=平台，1=店铺) is the switch for distributor-level payment settlement: 0 means the store settles through the platform's merchant accounts, and 1 means it collects through its own per-shop payment configuration.

`PaymentSubjectDistributorIdPort` is a one-method common-bundle port (`long resolveActualDistributorId(long companyId, long distributorId)`) declared in ecshopx-common/payment, so orders and payment consumers depend on the common port and never on the distribution bundle.

`PaymentSubjectDistributorIdPortImpl` in ecshopx-distribution resolves the settlement distributor id flag-only: it returns 0 immediately when distributorId is 0, otherwise runs a LIMIT 1 DistributorMapper lookup scoped by (company_id, distributor_id) and returns 0 when the row is missing, and returns the distributor id unchanged only when the row's paymentSubject equals 1 (null-safe comparison), collapsing every other flag value to 0.

Payment consumers resolve the payment-subject distributor id through the common port before touching payment configuration: OrdersPaymentDoPaymentService.doPayment resolves it once and uses the resolved id for payment-config validation while the trade keeps the original distributor_id, and OrdersPaymentChannelQueryService resolves it for channel status queries.

`OrdersPaymentDoPaymentServicePaymentSubjectTest` pins the orders-side payment-subject contract: doPayment consults PaymentSubjectDistributorIdPort and validates payment configuration against distributor id 0 when the port resolves the platform subject.
